In which year was the cumulative manufacturing of aerated drinks by B and C is highest?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Aerated drinks manufactured together by company B and C in 2019 = 200 + 140 = 340

Aerated drinks manufactured together by company B and C in 2020 = 230 + 170 = 400

Aerated drinks manufactured together by company B and C in 2021 = 210 + 195 = 405

Aerated drinks manufactured together by company B and C in 2022 = 175 + 190 = 365 

Clearly shows that, most of the aerated drinks manufactured together by company B and C is in 2021

∴ The correct option is 1.
